tokens.npc_dota_hero_weaver_bio:
The fabric of creation needs constant care, lest it grow tattered; for when it unravels, whole worlds come undone. It is the work of the Weavers to keep the fabric tight, to repair worn spots in the mesh of reality. They also defend from the things that gnaw and lay their eggs in frayed regions, whose young can quickly devour an entire universe if the Weavers let their attention lapse. Skitskurr was a master Weaver, charged with keeping one small patch of creation tightly woven and unfaded. But the job was not enough to satisfy. It nagged him that the original work of creation all lay in the past; the Loom had done its work and travelled on. He wanted to create rather than merely maintain--to weave worlds of his own devising. He began making small changes to his domain, but the thrill of creation proved addictive, and his strokes became bolder, pulling against the pattern that the Loom had woven.

The guardians came, with their scissors, and Weaver's world was pared off, snipped from the cosmic tapestry, which they rewove without him in it. Skitskurr found himself alone, apart from his kind, a state that would have been torment for any other Weaver. But Skitskurr rejoiced, for now he was free. Free to create for himself, to begin anew. The raw materials he needed to weave a new reality were all around him. All he had to do was tear apart this old world at the seams.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_weaver_hype: Weaver has no trouble evading enemies to position himself for another strike. Slipping in and out of sight, he avoids death by rewinding himself to an earlier position and health state. His arsenal of elusive skills ensures he is always a critical nuisance to his foes.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_weaver_npedesc1: Rewinds time to reverse damage and position

* Has the following unit additional properties:
** These {{M|attached-type units}} first spawn randomly around Weaver within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:The Swarm value2}} radius.
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
*** Take {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:The Swarm value1}}/{{#var:The Swarm basic1}}}} seconds to travel the max distance.
*** Have {{M|attack immune|text=attack immunity}}.
*** Can latch on valid enemy units {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:The Swarm value1}}+{{#var:The Swarm value2}}+{{#var:The Swarm value3}}}} range away, with the max travel distance, spawn radius, and latch radius.
*** Grants {{M|flying vision}} throughout the travel duration.
** {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Affected enemy units may only have one attached {{U|Beetle}} at any time.
*** Has the following latch-on properties:
**** Latches 64-distance north of a non-Beetle-affected enemy unit within its latch radius.
**** Grants {{M|flying vision}} centered around itself upon latching on a valid enemy unit.
*** Do not latch on the following units:
**** An already Beetle-affected enemy unit.
**** {{M|Couriers}}
**** Already {{M|hidden}} units.
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*** Can latch on the following units:
**** The Beetle continues latching on the affected enemy unit if the {{M|hidden|x}} source is applied after being latched on.
*** Affected units turning {{M|invulnerable}} {{M|instant kill}} the Beetle, and neither grants the {{M|gold}} nor {{M|experience}} bounty to anyone.

* {{Symbol|Attached-type Units}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|weaver_swarm_debuff}}
*** Affects the following units:
**** {{M|Ethereal}} units.
*** Does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Invulnerable|x}} units.
*** The ability effects are applied as follows in {{#var:The Swarm type1 value2}}-second intervals, starting immediately upon latching on valid enemy units:

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Additionally applies a dormant debuff to enemy heroes whenever Weaver damages them.

If Weaver remains within proximity distance of the debuff-affected enemy hero a certain time, the debuff becomes active and applies a movement speed slow.

fields.value: Grants bonus attack damage per activated debuff per hero, as long as Weaver is within the break distance.

fields.name: desc3

Additionally, the debuff-affected enemy hero's death now also refreshes and increases the buff duration.

** Does not interrupt Weaver's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.

***** {{M|Haste movement}}.

fields.value: If Skitskurr does not deem the current reality of the world to fit his desires, he simply crawls back in time to right what was wronged.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in a few seconds earlier — regaining both health and mana values from that time.

Neither affects current ability cooldowns nor gold and experience.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Enables casting on allied heroes, applying most Time Lapse effects on the unit-targeted allied hero.

Reduces cooldown.

** {{Symbol|Target|No}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Does not cancel {{M|shift-queue}} commands.
*** The ability effects are applied as follows:
***# {{M|Disjoints}} incoming {{M|projectiles}} upon cast.
***# The {{M|strong dispel}}. 
***# Issues a stop order once Weaver {{M|teleports}} back to the lapsed time coordinnates, this affects the following things:
***#* Interrupts Weaver's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
***#* Effectively cancels the ability's {{M|cast backswing}}.
***# [[Health#Setting Health|Sets]] Weaver's {{M|health}} and {{M|mana}} to the lapsed time value, prior its {{M|death}}.
***#* Neither utilizes {{M|heal}} nor {{M|mana restore}}. Hence, this does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
***#* Does not kill Weaver upon cast after respawning.
***#* {{cf|aghnotes}} The aformentioned death-related mechanics do not apply to an allied Time Lapse cast.

**** Enables Time Lapse casting on allied heroes, and changes the ability targeting functionality from {{Symbol|Target|No}} non-targeted to {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted.

**** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
***** {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability on Weaver akin to a {{Symbol|Target|No}} non-targeted cast.
***** When Weaver is {{M|invulnerable}}, it cannot utilize doubletap to self-cast.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_weaver
data.bio_loc:
The fabric of creation needs constant care, lest it grow tattered; for when it unravels, whole worlds come undone. It is the work of the Weavers to keep the fabric tight, to repair worn spots in the mesh of reality. They also defend from the things that gnaw and lay their eggs in frayed regions, whose young can quickly devour an entire universe if the Weavers let their attention lapse. Skitskurr was a master Weaver, charged with keeping one small patch of creation tightly woven and unfaded. But the job was not enough to satisfy. It nagged him that the original work of creation all lay in the past; the Loom had done its work and travelled on. He wanted to create rather than merely maintain--to weave worlds of his own devising. He began making small changes to his domain, but the thrill of creation proved addictive, and his strokes became bolder, pulling against the pattern that the Loom had woven.

The guardians came, with their scissors, and Weaver's world was pared off, snipped from the cosmic tapestry, which they rewove without him in it. Skitskurr found himself alone, apart from his kind, a state that would have been torment for any other Weaver. But Skitskurr rejoiced, for now he was free. Free to create for himself, to begin anew. The raw materials he needed to weave a new reality were all around him. All he had to do was tear apart this old world at the seams.
data.hype_loc: Weaver has no trouble evading enemies to position himself for another strike. Slipping in and out of sight, he avoids death by rewinding himself to an earlier position and health state. His arsenal of elusive skills ensures he is always a critical nuisance to his foes.
data.npe_desc_loc: Rewinds time to reverse damage and position

abilities.name: weaver_the_swarm
abilities.desc_loc: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
abilities.lore_loc: Skitskurr opens a gap in the space time fabric, allowing young Weavers to slip through and aid him in combat.
notes_loc: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in %destroy_attacks% attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.
facets_loc: Weaver gains experience when The Swarm beetles attack heroes.

abilities.name: weaver_shukuchi
abilities.desc_loc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
abilities.lore_loc: As the Weavers worked in the fabric of creation, small wormholes allowed them to slip through time to better work their craft.
notes_loc: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.
abilities.shard_loc: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last %geminate_attack_mark_duration% seconds. %shukuchi_attack_delay%s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within %shukuchi_attack_mark_radius% range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack
facets_loc: Shukuchi movespeed increased and slows enemies when passing through them.

abilities.name: weaver_geminate_attack
abilities.desc_loc: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
abilities.lore_loc: Skitskurr's relationship with time is somewhat variable, causing his actions to be witnessed - and felt - more than once.
notes_loc: Additional attacks leave Weaver %delay% seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.
abilities.shard_loc: Geminate Attack will also hit units within %shard_beetle_search_range% range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.

abilities.name: weaver_time_lapse
abilities.desc_loc:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: If Skitskurr does not deem the current reality of the world to fit his desires, he simply crawls back in time to right what was wronged.
notes_loc: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
abilities.scepter_loc: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with %abilitycastrange% cast range.

abilities.name: weaver_threads_of_fate
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within %thread_setup_distance% range of them for %thread_setup_time%s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

officialDataset.interpretation: Official website declarations, retained in full; not an assertion of complete engine verification.
